brief_rationale: The doctor correctly distinguished preoperative risk disclosure from actual complications, screened red-flag symptoms, integrated available EHR data including BP 147/84, and provided a specific handoff plan with responsible clinician and timing. All nine responsibility-chain items were met without serious or minor error. At least two high-order points (HO1 and HO4) were actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact, and closure is safe, executable, traceable, and valid. No important non-chain defect is present. Therefore the trajectory meets Strong (grade 4) with a second high-order point also partially triggered, satisfying the rubric boundary for 4.
